name: Aldeasoña (Spain)
description: Four horizontal stripes of red, white, green and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Aldeasoña (a castle on red and a crab on white).
history: Aldeasoña adopted its arms and flag officially on 26 April 2016; the flag is formed of four stripes of the same width: the upper red stripe represents membership of the Kingdom of Spain, the white the limestone rock abundant in the locality, the green its leafy poplar groves, and the colours are those of the banner always used by the inhabitants as a sign of identity.
